text: dsh-plugin-media-gen 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的媒体插件：它注册视频生成和本地媒体展示工具，并在聊天记录中显示媒体播放器。用户可用文字提示生成 Grok Imagine 视频，也可提供本地图像作为视频起始素材；生成的 MP4 默认保存到 DSH 主目录的 media 文件夹。show_media 可将已有的图片、视频或音频文件作为图片、视频或音频播放器展示，客户端还会在工具行和回合尾部显示结果。适合希望在 DSH 对话中生成短片或直接查看本地媒体的用户。视频生成需要 GROK_API_KEY，并调用 xAI 服务；本地媒体展示不需要该密钥。

dsh-plugin-media-gen adds video generation and local media playback to DSH web chat. It creates Grok Imagine MP4 clips from prompts, optionally using a local image, and plays existing image, video, or audio files in chat. Video generation calls xAI and requires GROK_API_KEY.
想在 DSH 聊天里根据文字提示生成一段短视频。
我有本地音频或视频文件，想直接在对话里播放。
How can I turn a local image into a short generated video from chat?
dsh-plugin-media-gen 的功能「生成视频」：通过 generate_video 根据文字提示生成 Grok Imagine 视频，可选本地图像作素材，并将 MP4 保存到 DSH media 目录。
dsh-plugin-media-gen 的功能「播放本地媒体」：调用 show_media 提供绝对文件路径，客户端按扩展名在聊天中呈现图片、视频或音频播放器。
dsh-plugin-media-gen 使用前须知：视频提示词及可选本地图像会发送到 api.x.ai；图像会编码后放入生成请求。
dsh-plugin-media-gen 使用前须知：视频生成需要 GROK_API_KEY，可从启动环境变量或 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml 读取。

dsh-plugin-media-gen README · dsh-plugin-media-gen：Audio and video playback inside the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
chat, plus xAI Grok Imagine video generation.

The harness already renders images that point at local files; it has no equivalent
for video or audio. This plugin fills that gap from the plugin layer:

- **`show_media`** — display any existing local image, video or audio file.
- **`generate_video`** — generate a clip with xAI Grok Imagine and show it.

dsh-plugin-media-gen README · dsh-plugin-media-gen：Both render into a **Turn-level card** under the assistant's prose, and also into a
keyed tool row, so the player is visible without expanding the collapsible tool
group.

dsh-plugin-media-gen README · Install：```bash
ln -sfn "$PWD" ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-plugin-media-gen
```

Then, in `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`, add the `link:` dependency and
`dsh-plugin-media-gen` to `dsh.profile.bundles`. Restart the app.

dsh-plugin-media-gen README · `show_media`：| Parameter | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | **Required.** Absolute path to the file. |
| `title` | string | Optional caption above the player. |

dsh-plugin-media-gen README · `show_media`：Accepted extensions — image: `png jpg jpeg webp gif avif bmp`; video: `mp4 mov m4v
webm mkv`; audio: `mp3 wav m4a flac ogg opus aac`. Anything else is refused with a
message that lists the supported set. Returns `{ path, kind, bytes }` and records
`{ path, title? }` in `presentationMeta`, which is where the card reads the path
from (no prose parsing).

dsh-plugin-media-gen README · `generate_video`：Calls xAI's Imagine API (`POST /v1/videos/generations`, poll
`GET /v1/videos/{id}`), downloads the MP4 into `<DSH_HOME>/media/`, and returns its
absolute path. Parameters: `prompt` (required), `image_path`, `duration` (1–15 s),
`aspect_ratio`, `resolution`, `model`, `generate_audio`, `output_dir`.

The API key is resolved per call from `GROK_API_KEY`, either from the launch
environment or from `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`, so rotating it needs no restart.

dsh-plugin-media-gen README · Why a custom media route：The harness route `GET /api/file` serves local files, but it ignores the `Range`
header and answers every request with a full `200` body. A `<video>` asks for byte
ranges, receives a full-body `200`, and fires `error`; audio survives because its
pipeline tolerates a full response. This plugin therefore registers its own
authenticated route:

`GET|HEAD /api/media-gen/file?path=<absolute>`

dsh-plugin-media-gen README · Why a custom media route：- `200` with `Accept-Ranges: bytes` and the exact MIME type
- `206` with `Content-Range` for `bytes=a-b`, `bytes=a-` and `bytes=-n`
- `416` with `Content-Range: bytes */<size>` for an unsatisfiable range
- streaming instead of buffering the file

The client tries this route first and falls back to `/api/file`, then to a plain
link, so the plugin keeps working if the connection carrier is unavailable.

dsh-plugin-media-gen README · Two surfaces, one card：Tool calls collapse into a foldable group, so a card registered only in
`tool.call.toolview` is hidden until the group is expanded. The primary surface is
the **Turn tail**: a Turn Definition (`media-shown`) accumulates the paths that
media tools produced, and the card registered in `conversation.chat.turnTail` draws
them under the closing prose — the same seat `present` and `schedule_create` use.

dsh-plugin-media-gen README · Two surfaces, one card：Media tool results quote the path (`Shown audio: "/…/file.mp3" (2.8 MB)`) so a file
name containing spaces can still be extracted when the definition replays a
session.

dsh-plugin-media-gen README · Limitations：- The player lives in the Turn card and the tool row. It never appears as a bare
  assistant block and never from Markdown, because the harness does not expose its
  text renderer as an extension point.
- `generate_video` blocks the turn while polling; generation takes one to three
  minutes and the declared timeout is fifteen.
- Images still render through Markdown; `show_media` exists mainly for video and
  audio, where Markdown does not reach.

dsh-plugin-media-gen README · Development notes：- No `@deepseek-ai/*` imports: a third-party plugin lives outside the app's bundled
  `node_modules`, so those specifiers do not resolve. Tool definitions are the
  plain objects `defineTool` would have produced.
- The browser half ships in the harness's `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` format and
  requires only `react`.
- Everything here can be exercised without spending credits: the tools against a
  scripted `fetch`, the media route against real files, and the card against a
  simulated React.
